title: odontarrhena debarensis
intro: Odontarrhena debarensis, commonly known as Chinese Angelica, is a plant species in the family Apiaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine, particularly in Chinese herbalism, where it is valued for its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Odontarrhena debarensis include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and diuretic effects, which help alleviate conditions such as menstrual cramps, fever, and urinary issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include volatile oils, flavonoids, and coumarins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
